newsitem.title: CANADA: CBRS places Abitibi-Price under review.
newsitem.headline: CBRS places Abitibi-Price under review.

text.p: Canadian Bond Rating Service said on Monday it placed the ratings of Abitibi-Price Inc under review following the company's announcement last Friday it is merging with Stone-Consolidated Corp.
CBRS said both companies have "relatively modest" debt for their size. Stone-Consolidated has a total of C$770 million of debt and Abitibi-Price had about C$678 million at year end.

With more than 25 percent of Canadian production capacity and more than eight percent of world newsprint capacity, the merged company, Abitibi-Consolidated, could exert significant market leadership in the communications papers market, the rating agency said.
The agency's current ratings for Abitibi-Price are: A-2(High) for its commercial paper; B++(Low) for its sinking fund debentures; and P-3(Low) for its preferred shares.
After the merger, Stone Container Corp, of Chicago, would hold a 25 percent stake in Stone-Consolidated.
